Project Summary: Astronaut Health Monitoring Application
Overview
Developed for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge by team SARAJTEAM40 (saraj_team40), this application is a pure-software astronaut health monitoring system designed to track, visualize, and analyze critical physiological and environmental telemetry in real time. The project prioritizes robust functional software quality, high-performance data handling, and a polished, professional user interface optimized for mission control and crew usability.

Key Features & Capabilities
Real-Time Telemetry & Vital Sign Tracking: Monitors core astronaut health metrics—such as heart rate, blood oxygen saturation (SpO₂), stress levels, and fatigue indicators—alongside spacecraft environmental parameters.

Professional UI/UX Design: Features a clean, high-contrast, mission-ready dashboard built for quick data comprehension during high-stress scenarios.

Pure-Software Architecture: Streamlined to eliminate hardware dependencies (such as physical microcontrollers or sensors), ensuring frictionless deployment, reliable simulation capabilities, and consistent cross-platform performance.

Android & Multi-Device Readiness: Structured for seamless packaging as a standalone Android application and integration into broader mission support workflows.
